scope: Read-only upstream source and preserved-log review; board/application actions owned by parent

versions.gnome-desktop: 44.3 source examined; installed library version not independently checked

findings.evidence: cc-mouse-panel.ui references9 WebM illustration resources. cc-mask-paintable.c:454 constructs GtkMediaFile immediately; cc-illustrated-row.c plays/pauses on hover/leave. Multiple GtkGstPlay/GL threads are expected from initialization.
findings.limits: The last selected mouse panel does not establish the initial panel when the90second complaint began.

findings.evidence: GTK gtkgstsink.c:633-657 wraps GDK EGL/X11 context then790 creates a shared Gst context. GST_GL_API=gles2/GST_GL_PLATFORM=egl and optional GST_GL_WINDOW=x11 are supported per official GStreamer running documentation. Gst EGL backend936 already prefersGLES if allowed.
findings.decision: A valid single-process diagnostic, not a proven permanent fix. Preserved warm-default trial reached951 CPUticks by10seconds versus forced-GLES1685 by15seconds. Cache/order and mapped-versus-drawn limits prevent strong startup conclusions, but forcing is not supported as a speed improvement.

findings.evidence: GTK gtkmediafile.c:195 selects GTK_MEDIA. Built-in gtknomediafile.c registers none. GTK_MEDIA=none disables only media backend, keeping GSK GL available.
findings.decision: Diagnostic only; removes animated illustrations. New process required because GApplication forwards requests to existing process without replacing its environment.

findings.evidence: GCC cc-background-item.c:354-361 intentionally queues one asynchronous worker;286 calls gnome_bg_create_thumbnail. cc-background-paintable.c callbacks create GdkTexture and invalidate size. Both light/dark variants are queued for chooser previews.
findings.limits: No explicit UI-thread wait is present here. Eight similarly named threads are not evidence of eight GCC queue workers; inner image-library parallelism or other stacks must be sampled.

findings.evidence: gnome-desktop44.3 gnome-bg.c:2168 checks thumbnail byURI/mtime. Miss at2175 loads/renders full original via gdk_pixbuf_new_from_file;2190 scales afterwards and2205 saves PNG. Factory paths use g_get_user_cache_dir()/thumbnails/<size>.
findings.hypothesis: Complex high-resolution SVG wallpapers can make first-cache generation CPU-intensive, then become cheapPNG reads. Parent observed new large thumbnailPNGs during initial Settings run. Causality still requires isolated-cache A/B.

recommended_next_comparison.panel: explicit background panel on a freshSettings PID
recommended_next_comparison.cache_isolation: New XDG_CACHE_HOME preserving other existing cache members, but new empty thumbnails directory; second run reuses same temporary cache. Do not delete real user cache. Starting with entirely empty XDG_CACHE_HOME also invalidates font/Gst/GSK caches and confounds causality.
